name: Shismai
title: Descendant of Judah
summary: Shismai was a descendant of Judah through the Jerahmeel clan. He is mentioned in 1 Chronicles as the son of Elasa and father of Shallum. His significance lies primarily in his place in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Judah's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Shismai is recorded as the son of Elasa in the genealogy of the Jerahmeel clan, which is part of the tribe of Judah's family tree.

keyEvents.title: Father of Shallum
keyEvents.description: Shismai is mentioned as the father of Shallum, thus continuing the line of the Jerahmeel clan within the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Part of Jerahmeel's Lineage
keyEvents.description: Shismai belongs to the longer lineage from Jerahmeel, Ram's brother, which is an important branch of the tribe of Judah described in Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Placement in Israel's Family History
keyEvents.description: Through the genealogy, Sismai is linked to the broader history of the tribes of Israel, particularly the prominent role of the tribe of Judah.
